title: The Gerundio
subtitle: parlando, credendo, dormendo. Present gerund with stare.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: This lesson covers the gerundio. Italian grammar builds on patterns you have already learned. Focus on recognizing forms in context before producing them.

sections.heading: From Italian literature
sections.body: Real examples from Dante, Petrarch, Boccaccio, Machiavelli, Leopardi, or Manzoni illustrate this grammatical point in living use.

items.prompt: What is the main function of the gerundio?
